about: Online price, filled by the owner before `report`. USD per million tokens, copied from the provider's official pricing page on the date in checked_on. Leave null to report tokens instead of money. No caching or batch discount assumed. No currency conversion: the episode says dollars.

fallback.about: NOT a real price. A deliberately high ceiling used only for the upper-bound estimate before `run --online` when the model's own price is still null. It is never used in `report` and never said on camera.
